Class ClientModel

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am54.network.client.ClientModel
public class ClientModel extends Object
============================================================================ ClientModel — Lightweight client-side model ============================================================================ ROLE: Maintain a local game state synchronized with the server. Receives Updates from ServerHandler (TCP) or RMIServerConnection (RMI) and updates its state accordingly. WHY IT EXISTS: The server-side Model (Game.java) is heavy: it contains game logic, cards, effects, etc. The client doesn't need all of this. ClientModel contains ONLY the data necessary to display the game state: player names, cards on the board, colors, turns, etc. SYNCHRONIZATION: All update methods are synchronized to ensure thread-safety. ServerHandler runs on a separate thread and updates ClientModel concurrently with the UI thread. STRUCTURE: 1. GLOBAL STATE: round, era, current state, turn player 2. BOARD: cards on table, turn order, offering track 3. PLAYERS: nickname, colors, resources (food, aura), card inventory 4. EXTRA: winners, errors, disconnected players ============================================================================

    • updateCardPicked

      public void updateCardPicked(String nickname, String row, int index, int newFoodBalance, int newMagicBalance, Map<Integer,String> updatedOffering)
      Reflects picking a card: removes the card from the correct row (character or building based on index), adds it to the player's tribe/buildings, updates food and magic, and replaces the offering track with the one updated by the server.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the player who picked
      row - the row ("upper" or "lower")
      index - the card index (characters followed by buildings)
      newFoodBalance - the new food balance
      newMagicBalance - the new magic balance
      updatedOffering - the updated offering track

    • updateTotemReturned

      public void updateTotemReturned(String nickname, int newFoodBalance, int newAuraBalance)
      Reflects the return of a player's totem from the offering tile to the turn order: frees their tile (marking it "VUOTO" without losing bonus/ID), reinserts them in the first truly available slot (skipping "ghosts") and updates food and aura.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the player whose totem returns
      newFoodBalance - the new food balance
      newAuraBalance - the new aura balance
